Synopsis:
    A technical fault at UK air traffic control provider NATS caused widespread flight disruption across major UK airports on the day of publication. Departures were most severely affected, with Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, London City, Manchester, Belfast City, Birmingham, and Edinburgh all reporting delays or cancellations. Arrivals continued but some inbound flights were held abroad. Resolution timeline was uncertain, with disruption expected into the evening.
